children: ABB's joint venture with Mitsubishi Electric looks like a sensible move for the Swiss engineering group, RBC Capital Markets' Sebastian Kuenne and Nick Housden write in a research note. The deal extends ABB's electrification franchise into Japan's sizable market at a reasonable price, the analysts say. It adds around $640 million of revenue and makes ABB the leader of the Japanese low-voltage power distribution market, they add. The electrification division was a standout performer for ABB in the third quarter, with orders growing 70% organically and beating consensus expectations by 16%, according to RBC.(adria.calatayud@wsj.com)
